1000008.Name: Windbloom
1000008.Desc: When Velina enters the battlefield, she gains 45 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>. Using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow</color> grants 45 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>, up to a maximum of 135 points. With enough <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm</color>.

1000009.Name: Top Hat Companion
1000009.Desc:
When using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hat Trick</color>, the thrown hat:
Is actually a Bangboo. While Top Hat Companion is on the field, it accumulates Preheated Chamber in Norma's place. When Norma retrieves the Top Hat Companion, all accumulated Preheated Chamber is transferred to her.
Top Hat Companion inherits all of Norma's stats.

1000010.Name: En-Nah Turret
1000010.Desc:
The white turret summoned by <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: En-Nah Barrage</color>:
Automatically uses Special Attack: Target Practice at regular intervals. After deploying its missile bay, this skill is replaced with EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment.
En-Nah Turrets inherit all of Norma's stats.

1000011.Name: Preheated Chamber
1000011.Desc:
While Norma or her Top Hat Companion is on the field, gain 1.5% Preheated Chamber per second.
When Preheated Chamber reaches 80% or higher, the Quick Assist triggered by Basic Attack: Hat Trick is <color=#FFFFFF>replaced with a Chain Attack</color>.

1000012.Name: En-Nah Barrage
1000012.Desc:
The buff gained from <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: En-Nah Barrage</color>:
During its active duration, two En-Nah Turrets are summoned to fight alongside Norma.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Advantage in Numbers</color> is triggered, Norma's ATK is further increased, and all squad members deal increased DMG.

1000013.Name: Tech Divide
1000013.Desc:
The debuff applied when Norma or her creations hit an enemy:
For the duration of the effect, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier is increased, and the duration of its Stunned state is extended.

1000014.Name: Windbite
1000014.Desc: When Velina triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, she gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>. When Velina has 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>, the next time she triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, she consumes 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color> to increase that instance's DMG Multiplier.

1000015.Name: Condensed Cyclone
1000015.Desc: When Velina triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, she summons a <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Cyclone</color> that deals <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>. When the <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Cyclone</color> dissipates, it triggers an explosion. If the explosion hits an enemy afflicted with a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it deals one instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG.

1000016.Name: Sweeping Cyclone
1000016.Desc: When Velina uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm</color> or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> while consuming 2 points of <Term:1000014>Windbite</Term>, she summons a <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> to continuously deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> that is capable of triggering the <Term:1000017>Chromatic Tint</Term> effect. When <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> attacks hit enemies, the enemy's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly Buildup RES</color> and the corresponding <color=#FFFFFF>Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> are reduced. When <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> dissipates, it triggers an explosion. If the explosion hits an enemy suffering a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it deals one instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG.

1000017.Name: Chromatic Tint
1000017.Desc: When <Term:1000016>Sweeping Cyclone</Term> hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Contamination</color> for the first time, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> effect, converting into a <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> of the corresponding attribute and dealing the corresponding attribute's DMG.

1000018.Name: Solar Prominence
1000018.Desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, Pyrois gains 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color>. Different attacks grant a certain amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color> when they hit enemies, and Pyrois also gains a certain amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color> every second.
With 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate Basic Attack: Celestial Light. Each hit from Basic Attack: Celestial Light consumes a certain amount of Solar Prominence.

1000019.Name: Mirage
1000019.Desc: Pyrois enters the Mirage state when using Ultimate: Total Annihilation. While in the Mirage state, Pyrois' Ultimate deals increased CRIT DMG against Stunned enemies.

1000020.Name: Sunflare
1000020.Desc: Pyrois enters the Sunflare state when using Ultimate: Triumphant Return. While Sunflare is active, Energy Generation Rate and DMG dealt increase, and triggering a Perfect Block with an EX Special Attack restores additional <Term:1000018></Term>.

1000021.Name: Totalize
1000021.Desc:
Grants a special effect against Stunned enemies.
When Pyrois triggers Totalize, additional DMG is dealt, and the target's Stunned state ends.

1000022.Name: Cinderfire
1000022.Desc: Gain Cinderfire when using a Chain Attack. All Cinderfire stacks are consumed upon using an Ultimate, granting a certain amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Decibels</color> for each stack consumed.

1000023.Name: Anomaly Effect Strength
1000023.Desc:
When applying Attribute Anomaly Buildup to an enemy, each attack's ATK, PEN, Anomaly Proficiency, DMG Bonus, and other effects proportionally increase the resulting <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly Effect Strength</color> based on that attack's contribution to the total Attribute Anomaly Buildup.
PEN effects: Includes PEN and PEN Ratio
DMG Bonus: Includes both non-Attribute DMG Bonus and Attribute DMG Bonus

1000024.Name: Purr Energy
1000024.Desc:
Nekomata gains 40 Purr Energy upon entering the battlefield. She recovers 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Purr Energy</color> every second, and different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy on hit.
When Purr Energy is at least 40, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail.
When Purr Energy is at least 40, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 40 Purr Energy and directly activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.

1000025.Name: Pawpad Ambush
1000025.Desc:
Nekomata enters Pawpad Ambush state for 40s after using Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While Pawpad Ambush is active, all of Nekomata's attacks count as hitting from behind and trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 30% of Nekomata's ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.

1000026.Name: Fright
1000026.Desc: While <color=#FFFFFF><Term:1000027></Term></color> is active, each activation of Drusilla or Anastella's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup</color> grants 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Fright</color>. Upon reaching 6 stacks, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup</color> consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Fright</color> stacks and is replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Midnight Cleanup</color>.

1000027.Name: Spotless
1000027.Desc: While this is active, Drusilla or Anastella automatically uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup</color> to attack enemies and gain <color=#FFFFFF><Term:1000026></Term></color>. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

1000028.Name: Formation Breaker
1000028.Desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice</color> hits a Stunned elite or boss enemy for the first time, Sigrid enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Formation Breaker</color> state.
While in <color=#FFFFFF>Formation Breaker</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to continuously use the 1st through 3rd stages of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>.

1000029.Name: Unbridled Spear
1000029.Desc:
The 4th hit of the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> are considered <color=#FFFFFF>Unbridled Spear</color> skills.
When Sigrid hits an enemy with any <color=#FFFFFF>Unbridled Spear</color>, if she is not currently in the <Term:1000030></Term> state, she enters the <Term:1000030></Term> state and gains 1 activation of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>, up to 1 activation can be stored.

1000030.Name: Aerial Patrol Spear
1000030.Desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>. When Sigrid uses any <Term:1000029></Term>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> state is refreshed, and she gains 1 activation of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>. Up to 1 activation can be stored.

1000031.Name: Refringe
1000031.Desc: If an enemy has <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color>, when they're about to be inflicted with an Anomaly, that Anomaly is <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>. After being <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>, the Anomaly's <Term:1000023></Term> is enhanced based on the provider's <color=#FFA9DD>Refringe Coefficient</color>, increasing the total DMG that Anomaly can deal.

1000032.Name: Floating Radiance
1000032.Desc:
Remielle can gain <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> through <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> reaches its maximum of 120, Remielle can enter the <Term:1000035></Term> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is consumed over time. When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is fully consumed, Remielle exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state.
1000032.Skill: Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn

1000033.Name: Voidflare
1000033.Desc: When a squad member triggers Remielle's <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux</color> <Term:1000031></Term> reaction, Remielle generates <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color> based on the enhanced <Term:1000023></Term> of that Attribute Anomaly after it has been <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>. Up to the 3 most recently generated <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflares</color> can be stored.
1000033.Skill: Core Passive: Temporal Patterns = Stilled Colors

1000034.Name: Luminize
1000034.Desc: Deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to enemies using the skill's DMG Multiplier, based on the <Term:1000023></Term> of all stored <Term:1000033></Term>.
1000034.Skill: Core Passive: Temporal Patterns = Stilled Colors

1000035.Name: Phase Flow
1000035.Desc: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. During this, some attacks can also apply <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to the target. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, <Term:1000032></Term> is consumed over time. When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is fully depleted, she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state. Before exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, she cannot be actively switched in except through <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>.
1000035.Skill: Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn

2000001.Name: Corruptive Barrier
2000001.Desc:
· <color=#FFAF2C>CRIT DMG RES, ATK, and Anti-Interrupt</color> are increased while all Agents in the squad lose HP over time.
· When the Corruptive Barrier is broken, a portion of HP is converted into HP for all Agents in the squad, and Energy is restored.

2000002.Name: Miasmic Shield
2000002.Desc:
· <color=#FFAF2C>DEF, DMG reduction</color>, and <color=#FFAF2C>Anti-Interrupt</color> are significantly enhanced, and the enemy will not be Stunned. Agents can deplete the Miasmic Shield through attacks.
· When the Miasmic Shield is broken, enemies take <color=#FFAF2C>Purify</color> DMG, and Agents <color=#FFAF2C>recover Energy or Adrenaline</color>.

2000003.Name: Control Skill
2000003.Desc:
· Skills <color=#FFAF2C>ignore the Invulnerable effect</color> and have no flash prompts. Agents cannot activate their Ultimates during this time. Only one Agent switch is allowed per enemy attack, and each Agent can only perform one dodge.
· <color=#FFAF2C>Defensive Assist</color> or <color=#FFAF2C>Evasive Assist</color> can be used to counter this skill. Successfully countering all skills inflicts the <color=#FFAF2C>Shutdown</color> effect on the enemy, dealing massive DMG and accumulating a large amount of Daze.

2000004.Name: Chain Parry
2000004.Desc:
· When an <color=#FFAF2C>×-shape golden light</color> prompt appears on an enemy attack, <color=#FFAF2C>tap twice</color> in quick succession on <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to trigger a Chain Parry. Both Agents will parry the attack together and <color=#FFAF2C>accumulate a large amount of Daze</color>;
· After successfully triggering a Chain Parry, tap <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a Chain Assault.

4000001.Name: Basic Technique
4000001.Desc: There are 3 buffs that can reduce the required score of an order, making the order <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon01> -1, <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon02> -1, and <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon03> -1

4000002.Name: Starfish
4000002.Desc: A type of Sea Materials used to make souvenirs, providing the scores needed to fulfill orders

4000003.Name: Bottle Cap
4000003.Desc: A type of Sea Materials used to make souvenirs, providing the scores needed to fulfill orders

4000004.Name: Giant Crab Claw
4000004.Desc: A type of Sea Materials used to make souvenirs, providing the scores needed to fulfill orders

4000005.Name: Conch
4000005.Desc: A type of Sea Materials used to make souvenirs, providing the scores needed to fulfill orders

4000006.Name: Pebble
4000006.Desc: A type of Sea Materials used to make souvenirs, providing the scores needed to fulfill orders

4000007.Name: Overflow Score
4000007.Desc: The portion of the Sea Materials score that exceeds the order score requirement when an order is completed

4000008.Name: Single-Color Order
4000008.Desc: Orders with only one score requirement, using the order's original required score as the benchmark

4000009.Name: Three-Color Order
4000009.Desc: Orders with three types of score requirements, judged by the order's original required score

4000010.Name: White Feather
4000010.Desc: When a skill is released, current order <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon01><IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon02><IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon03> randomly -1

4000011.Name: Black Feather
4000011.Desc: When a skill is released, a random Sea Materials <IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon01><IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon02><IconMap:Icon_SummerTide_SIcon03> randomly +1

4000012.Name: Durability
4000012.Desc: Reduces the Durability consumed by this Gear by 1, to a minimum of 1.

4000014.Name: Skill
4000014.Desc: All of the Agent's skill Lv. except Core Skill +<color=#2BAD00>1</color>.

4000015.Name: Shield
4000015.Desc: After being out of combat for <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s, gain a shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>3%</color> of Max HP. Can trigger at most once every <color=#2BAD00>30</color>s.

4000016.Name: Corrosion Resistance
4000016.Desc: Each time Corruption is triggered, DMG taken is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>15</color>s.

4000017.Name: Dodge
4000017.Desc: [Dodge] count +1, <color=#FFFFFF>[Perfect Dodge]</color> is easier to trigger when <color=#FFFFFF>[Dodging]</color>.

4000018.Name: Charge Up
4000018.Desc: When HP is above <color=#2BAD00>80%</color>, deal an additional <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> DMG and <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> Anomaly Buildup.

4000019.Name: Curtain
4000019.Desc: While in [Ether Veil], hitting an enemy increases their Stun DMG Multiplier by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>15</color>s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

4000020.Name: Skill
4000020.Desc: All of the Agent's skill Lv. except Core Skill +<color=#2BAD00>2</color>.

4000021.Name: Shield
4000021.Desc: After being out of combat for <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s, gain a shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> of Max HP. Can trigger at most once every <color=#2BAD00>30</color>s.

4000022.Name: Corrosion Resistance
4000022.Desc: Each time Corruption is triggered, DMG taken is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>30</color>s.

4000023.Name: Charge Up
4000023.Desc: When HP is above <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>, deal an additional <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> DMG and <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> Anomaly Buildup.

4000024.Name: Swift
4000024.Desc: After triggering [Perfect Dodge], CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

4000025.Name: Basic Attack
4000025.Desc: [Basic Attack] Upon hitting an enemy, increases own ATK by <color=#2BAD00>4%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s, stacking up to <color=#2BAD00>3</color> times.

4000026.Name: Abloom
4000026.Desc: After triggering [Abloom], the Agent's Anomaly DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>12</color>s, stacking up to <color=#2BAD00>2</color> times.

4000027.Name: Disorder
4000027.Desc: After triggering [Disorder], gain an effect that ignores <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> of the target's All-Attribute RES for <color=#2BAD00>12</color>s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

4000028.Name: Follow-up Attack
4000028.Desc: [Aftershock] On hit, causes your DMG to ignore <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> of the target's defense for <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s; repeated triggers reset the duration.

4000029.Name: Pierce
4000029.Desc: After using [EX Special Attack], Sheer DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>3%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>15</color>s, stacking up to <color=#2BAD00>2</color> times.

4000030.Name: Chain Attack
4000030.Desc: When a [Chain Attack] is unleashed, increases own CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>12</color>s. Gaining the effect again refreshes the duration.

4000031.Name: Blood Rage
4000031.Desc: When losing HP, the Agent's CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>8</color>s. Gaining this effect again refreshes its duration.

4000032.Name: Vortex
4000032.Desc: When [Vortex] is triggered, the Agent's Anomaly DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> for <color=#2BAD00>15</color>s. Gaining it again resets the duration.

4000033.Name: Energy Generation
4000033.Desc: Using an [Ultimate] generates <color=#2BAD00>20</color> Energy for the Agent.

4000034.Name: Stun
4000034.Desc: When an enemy is Dazed, restore <color=#2BAD00>300</color> Decibel. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>30</color> seconds.

10000081.Name: Windbloom
10000081.Desc: When Velina enters the battlefield, she gains 45 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>. Using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow</color> grants 45 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>, up to a maximum of 135 points. With enough <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm</color>.
